question: What inner locus is identified as the cremation ground because it devours time?
premises: Time is devoured within the body.
That inner locus is designated as a cremation ground.
Devouring time constitutes its defining function.
inference: Therefore the interior of the body is identified as the cremation ground.
plain_english: Within the body it devours time; therefore that inner locus is remembered as the cremation ground.
